title: Garage setback from the primary street
text: C3.3.3 Garages are set back from the primary street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3c. Table 3.3c Setback of garages from the primary street: R10 - R35 5.0m (Refer Figure 3.3c); R40 and above In accordance with Table 3.3a. In areas coded R2 - R35, setback of garages to the primary street may be reduced: i. to 4.5m where an existing or planned footpath, shared path or road alignment is located more than 1m from the street boundary; or ii. to 3m where the garage allows vehicles to be parked parallel to the street. The wall parallel to the street must include more than one opening.

exceptions.label: footpath or road more than 1 m from boundary

replaces.note: 4.5 -> 5.0 m at R10-R25; 0.5 m behind the dwelling reduction deleted (C4P1-081)
R30-R35 5.0 m with 4.5 m footpath reduction unchanged; 3 m parallel-parking reduction now also at R30-R35

verified.note: Values clear. The reduction paragraph says 'R2 - R35'; the figure cited as 3.3c is captioned 'Figure 3.3s'.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.3. Table 3.3c (p31): R10-R35 5.0 m (reduced to 4.5 m where a footpath, shared path or road alignment is more than 1 m from the boundary, or 3 m for parallel parking with more than one opening; the text says 'R2 - R35'). R40 and above follow Table 3.3a (C3.3.3#r40-plus). 'Garage' may catch ground-level undercroft parking beneath an apartment building; the draft does not say (C4P1-081). Stale labels on p31: 'Figure 3.3s', 'Table B column 7', Figure 3.3d citing Part B. Applies only where a garage is proposed (condition parking.garage.present, as for C3.3.3#r40-plus).
